description: Find OpenAny models and APIs by keywords and optional kind (api, model, or all; default all), provider, category, data_platform, data_product or capability. Model hits include model_id and, when the model catalog provides them, modalities, context length and a pricing summary. Returns bounded summaries and required inputs, not full schemas. Then call get_api. Keyword search supports limited bilingual aliases; it is not general semantic search.
name: search_apis
title: Search APIs and models
